title: MI60044: Geospatial Imaging And Geoinformatics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Concepts of geo-spatial images, image formats, geo-registraion and coding,
concepts of laser and radar images of the geospace, capture of laser and radar
data and their processing for 3D object and pattern recognition. Introduction
to random vectors, detection problems (binary decision problems), likelihood
ratio tests. Fundamental concepts of geo-informatics, concepts of regionalized
variables and spatial data in micro and macro domains, concepts of spatiotemporal data analysis, introduction to logistic regression, weight of
evidence, fuzzy set theory and application to spatial data modeling.
